exercises.problemHtml:
CSD201 PE · SP26 · Paper 1 (60 minutes, 4 × 2.5 marks) — the newest paper in the Exam Room (content/exams/CSD201-PE1). A fruit import-export store: today's shipment is a circular linked list (ShipmentCLL, only head, the last node points back to it), the warehouse is a BST ordered by fruitId (FruitBST). Assignment.java (given) loads data.txt (line 1 ids, 2 names, 3 quantities, 4 prices, 5 the id to remove, 6–7 the range) and writes the answers. You complete only the method bodies marked "Student's code starts from here" (helper methods are welcome). The given data.txt of the zip ends with two stray spaces after F08; this copy is trimmed so that f4 prints [F03,F08] exactly as the paper shows.

The exam format. The given project contains Main.java, Lib.java, Fruit.java, Assignment.java and ShipmentCLL.java, FruitBST.java. Only ShipmentCLL.java, FruitBST.java may be edited, and only where the paper allows it (the bodies marked "Student's code starts from here"): complete the functions below, keep every pre-given statement and add your statements in the marked places (you may add helper functions). Each fK() loads its own lines of data.txt, writes the answer to fK.txt, and Main prints that file. Choosing K in the menu runs fK only — exactly how the marking software runs your project, one choice per run.

  1. f1() — countFruits() (ShipmentCLL) — walk the circular list and return the number of fruits; 0 for an empty list.
  2. f2() — removeById(String id) (ShipmentCLL) — remove the node with that fruitId; handle every case: the only node, the head (the last node must point to the new head), another node, an id that is not there.
  3. f3() — insert(Fruit fruit) (FruitBST) — insert by fruitId (String order); an id already in the tree is ignored. f3 prints the in-order traversal.
  4. f4() — countInRange(String minId, String maxId) (FruitBST) — the number of fruits whose id is between minId and maxId inclusive; 0 if none.

The sample outputs below are produced from the paper’s data.txt (also in the download, next to cham.mjs). The hidden cases run the same choices on other data.txt files with the same layout — code that only matches the sample (hard-coded names, positions) fails them.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 20 case(s) (16 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Edit only ShipmentCLL.java, FruitBST.java, where the paper allows; Main.java, Lib.java, Fruit.java, Assignment.java stay exactly as given (rule G1).
  • No Vietnamese accents anywhere in your file(s) (rule P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, like the exam room’s JDK 1.8).
  • Run it like the exam: node cham.mjs runs Main once per choice 1–4 with the paper’s data.txt and with hidden data files.

Cửa hàng xuất nhập khẩu trái cây: lô hàng hôm nay là danh sách liên kết vòng (ShipmentCLL, chỉ có head, nút cuối trỏ về head), kho là BST sắp theo fruitId (FruitBST). Assignment.java (cho sẵn) nạp data.txt (dòng 1 mã, 2 tên, 3 số lượng, 4 giá, 5 mã cần xoá, 6–7 khoảng) và ghi đáp án. Bạn chỉ hoàn thiện thân các hàm đánh dấu "Student's code starts from here" (được viết hàm phụ). data.txt trong file zip có hai dấu cách thừa sau F08; bản ở đây đã cắt để f4 in đúng [F03,F08] như đề.

Khuôn đề thi. Project cho sẵn Main.java, Lib.java, Fruit.java, Assignment.java và ShipmentCLL.java, FruitBST.java. Chỉ được sửa ShipmentCLL.java, FruitBST.java, và chỉ ở chỗ đề cho phép (thân các hàm đánh dấu "Student's code starts from here"): hoàn thiện các hàm dưới đây, giữ nguyên mọi câu lệnh cho sẵn và chèn câu lệnh của bạn vào chỗ đánh dấu (được thêm hàm phụ). Mỗi fK() nạp các dòng riêng của data.txt, ghi đáp án vào fK.txt, và Main in tệp đó. Chọn K ở menu là chạy riêng fK — đúng cách phần mềm chấm chạy project, mỗi lần một lựa chọn.

  1. f1() — countFruits() (ShipmentCLL) — duyệt danh sách vòng và trả số trái cây; danh sách rỗng trả 0.
  2. f2() — removeById(String id) (ShipmentCLL) — xoá nút có fruitId đó; xử lý mọi trường hợp: nút duy nhất, nút head (nút cuối phải trỏ tới head mới), nút khác, mã không có.
  3. f3() — insert(Fruit fruit) (FruitBST) — chèn theo fruitId (thứ tự chuỗi); mã đã có thì bỏ qua. f3 in duyệt trung thứ tự.
  4. f4() — countInRange(String minId, String maxId) (FruitBST) — số trái cây có mã nằm giữa minId và maxId (tính cả hai đầu); không có thì 0.

Output mẫu bên dưới chạy với data.txt của đề (có trong bản tải, cạnh cham.mjs). Các ca ẩn chạy cùng các lựa chọn với những data.txt khác cùng bố cục — code chỉ khớp mẫu (gõ cứng tên, vị trí) sẽ trượt.

Chạy máy chấm trên máy bạn

Website KHÔNG chấm bài này. Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code, giải nén, sửa code trong src/, rồi trong thư mục bài (thư mục chứa cham.mjs) chạy:

Giải nén ra một thư mục mang tên bài (gọi là <thư-mục>). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 20 ca (16 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai, soát luật mã nguồn rồi cho điểm. exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: f1/f2 are the circular-list operations of chapter 1 (O(n)); the trick in f2 is to start from the node before head so that the head is not a special case. f3/f4 are a BST insert and a pruned range count on String keys (O(h) and O(h + k)). Ca 1 của mỗi lựa chọn tái hiện đúng output mẫu của đề.

mistakesJson.loi: A while (p != head) loop that starts at head — it stops immediately and counts 0 (or 1).|||Vòng while (p != head) bắt đầu ở head — dừng ngay và đếm ra 0 (hoặc 1).
Removing the head by head = head.next only — the last node still points to the removed node, the ring is broken.|||Xoá head chỉ bằng head = head.next — nút cuối vẫn trỏ vào nút đã xoá, vòng bị đứt.
Comparing ids with == or < — use equals and compareTo.|||So mã bằng == hay < — dùng equals và compareTo.

exercises.problemHtml:
CSD201 PE · SP26 · Block 5 · Paper 4 · Question 1 (4 marks) — the real files of the given zip (Q1/ folder): Drum(tower, sound, type), Node, Lib, Main, and MyList.java whose part (2) you complete. The paper’s own sample outputs (Exam Room CSD201-PE3) are reproduced by case 1 of every choice.

The exam format. The given project contains Main.java, Lib.java, Node.java, Drum.java and MyList.java. Only MyList.java may be edited, and only where the paper allows it (part (2)): complete the functions below, keep every pre-given statement and add your statements in the marked places (you may add helper functions). Each fK() loads its own lines of data.txt, writes the answer to fK.txt, and Main prints that file. Choosing K in the menu runs fK only — exactly how the marking software runs your project, one choice per run.

  1. f1() — addLast(xTower, xSound, xType) — if xTower.charAt(0) == 'B' do nothing, otherwise append a new node. Paper: (A,9,8) (C,6,5) (D,2,4) (E,7,9) (F,4,7).
  2. f2() — Given x = (X,1,2) and y = (Y,3,4): insert them so that x is the 3rd node and y the 5th (insert x at position 2 first, then y at position 4 of the new list).

  4. f4() — Assuming at least 4 elements, sort the LAST 4 elements in descending order of sound; the earlier nodes are untouched.

node cham.mjs

Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 12 case(s) (8 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

  • No Vietnamese accents anywhere in your file(s) (rule P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, like the exam room’s JDK 1.8).

exercises.problemHtml:
CSD201 PE · SP26 · Block 5 · Paper 4 · Question 2 (4 marks) — the real files of the Q2/ folder: Tiger(forest, rate, sound), Node (with unused bal, level), Queue for breadth-first, Lib, Main, and BSTree.java whose part (2) you complete. The BST is keyed by sound, which must be unique.

The exam format. The given project contains Main.java, Lib.java, Node.java, Tiger.java, Queue.java and BSTree.java. Only BSTree.java may be edited, and only where the paper allows it (part (2)): complete the functions below, keep every pre-given statement and add your statements in the marked places (you may add helper functions). Each fK() loads its own lines of data.txt, writes the answer to fK.txt, and Main prints that file. Choosing K in the menu runs fK only — exactly how the marking software runs your project, one choice per run.

  1. f1() — insert(xForest, xRate, xSound) — if xForest.charAt(0) == 'A' do nothing; otherwise insert keyed by sound (a sound already in the tree is ignored). The file gets breadth-first and in-order.
  2. f2() — Pre-order traversal, but display only the nodes with rate < 6 (copy preOrder to preOrder2 and modify it).
  3. f3() — Let p be the 4th node in pre-order traversal. Delete p by copying.
  4. f4() — Let p be the 4th node in pre-order traversal. If p has a right child, rotate p to the LEFT about its right child.

The sample outputs below are produced from the paper’s data.txt (also in the download, next to cham.mjs). The hidden cases run the same choices on other data.txt files with the same layout — code that only matches the sample (hard-coded names, positions) fails them.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 12 case(s) (8 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Edit only BSTree.java, where the paper allows; Main.java, Lib.java, Node.java, Tiger.java, Queue.java stay exactly as given (rule G1).
  • No Vietnamese accents anywhere in your file(s) (rule P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, like the exam room’s JDK 1.8).
  • Run it like the exam: node cham.mjs runs Main once per choice 1–4 with the paper’s data.txt and with hidden data files.

exercises.problemHtml:
CSD201 PE · SP26 · Block 5 · Paper 4 · Question 3 (2 marks) — the real files of the Q3/ folder: Graph.java (labels A…P, loadData(k), fvisit writing " X", breadth/depth with restarts), Queue, Stack, Lib, Main. The f1 matrix of the paper is not symmetric in one cell (row F has C, row C has no F): follow the rows exactly, as the given breadth does.

The exam format. The given project contains Main.java, Lib.java, Queue.java, Stack.java and Graph.java. Only Graph.java may be edited, and only where the paper allows it (part (2)): complete the functions below, keep every pre-given statement and add your statements in the marked places (you may add helper functions). Each fK() loads its own lines of data.txt, writes the answer to fK.txt, and Main prints that file. Choosing K in the menu runs fK only — exactly how the marking software runs your project, one choice per run.

  1. f1() — The breadth-first traversal from vertex 1 (B) is already written by breadth(1,f). On the next line write only the 3rd to the 7th vertices of that same order (copy breadth to breadth2 and modify it). Paper: B A E C D H G I F / E C D H G.
  2. f2() — Dijkstra on the weighted matrix of line 12 (99 = no edge). Line 1: the shortest path from A (0) to G (6). Line 2: the last 4 vertices put into S up to and including G (stop once G is in S), each as label|distance. Line 3: the shortest path from B (1) to F (5). Paper: A B C E D G / E|15 D|19 F|24 G|29 / B C E D F.

The sample outputs below are produced from the paper’s data.txt (also in the download, next to cham.mjs). The hidden cases run the same choices on other data.txt files with the same layout — code that only matches the sample (hard-coded names, positions) fails them.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Edit only Graph.java, where the paper allows; Main.java, Lib.java, Queue.java, Stack.java stay exactly as given (rule G1).
  • No Vietnamese accents anywhere in your file(s) (rule P…) — Java 8 (javac --release 8, like the exam room’s JDK 1.8).
  • Run it like the exam: node cham.mjs runs Main once per choice 1–2 with the paper’s data.txt and with hidden data files.
